attributes.action: Stop retrospective ILR rules and scrap income-based settlement thresholds
attributes.additional_details: The proposed "Earned Settlement" model undermines settlement rules, breaching institutional trust. Forcing current visa holders onto retrospective rules and stripping established rights causes undue harm before and after receiving ILR. Settlement is based on lawful residency and contribution, not salary. Income-based thresholds create an unjust hierarchy of work, ignoring our interconnected network where every job plays an essential role. These rules unfairly discriminate and should be scrapped.
attributes.background: We call on the government to protect existing visa holders' originally established path to settlement. Any new rules must only apply to future arrivals. Protect access to the safety net upon ILR settlement and uphold the current system based on time spent - not income-based thresholds.
